text: Loaded wet-dusk save: worst issue 'core drift 21% -37%/min on top' - module is on top of the boulder, out of reach from the trailhead (looking straight up only shows billing). Session clock is 'free' (session.json says clock free, not stepped as the brief says), so core rots in real time while I read screenshots: ~30s to zero. No hint on screen how to reach an 'on top' module.
HUD issue line 'i18n drift 91% -36%/min under: roll' runs off the right edge of the 640x360 window; the placement hint is truncated.
Behind-view (V) camera clips inside the boulder when the boulder is right behind Sisyphus: the whole screen is dark blue polygons and the player cannot tell where they are or which way they face.

At dusk/night, looking at the boulder face from 1 m away: the surface is near-black polygons with no visible marking of which module is where or which one is rotting. Only the crosshair prompt tells you ('sessions: healthy'); the HUD says storage is 'facing you' but nothing on the boulder shows where storage is, so I have to sweep the crosshair blind.

The rotting module's purple glow sits at the bottom of the boulder, exactly behind the controls help bar (F1). With help shown (as on load) the one visual cue for where the issue is gets covered; I only found storage after pressing F1 and looking down.

Crosshair on core ('core: dependency drift ... Hold E to patch'), within reach, held E for 8 s, 10 s and 6 s: no progress bar appears, no message, core keeps dropping (63%->58%). Earlier the same hold patched storage fine. Nothing on screen says why patching is refused (stamina? distance? the downed i18n?).

After pushing 6 s uphill from 29 m and releasing W: 'It is rolling back down! Let go only on a terrace: it stops at the one below.' Only 2 m gained for 6 s of pushing (heavy weight, slick). Earlier, letting go after 4 s at 30 m it did NOT roll back, so when the boulder slips on the slick path is unclear.

While holding W into the boulder at 24 m, it slipped past me and rolled back down: now 'The boulder: 10 m behind you', Next 1.2 back to 27 m. No warning / animation cue that it was about to slip; I just found myself walking uphill alone. The slick path is felt only as random loss.
Module name labels drawn on the boulder ('router') overlap the crosshair prompt text underneath, e.g. 'i18n: nearly new (97%)' rendered on top of 'router' so both are garbled.

Weight bar stays full ('too heavy to push uphill') after retiring uploads (Modules 14 -> 13): retiring does not visibly lighten the boulder, and the HUD never says what makes it heavy (downed modules? issue count?). With search/cache DOWN on the far side and underneath and the boulder too heavy to push, I see no way to reach them: a dead end. F (refactor uploads into router) held 7 s did nothing and gave no message.

HUD says 'ui DOWN facing you' but in first person the crosshair stays on 'search' across several look moves; ui's red glow is only visible as sparkles along the boulder's silhouette edge. 'Facing you' seems to include modules on the side edge that the crosshair can barely hit. Mouse look also moves very unevenly per pt look pixel at this frame rate (80 px barely moved, 200 px overshot).

Loaded 'wet-dusk' save: first minutes were dark dusk/night (town lights, near-black boulder), but ~15 real minutes later the sky is bright midday blue. I never reached nightfall; lighting seemed to go dusk -> night -> full day quickly (or the dark was facing-dependent). Rain line ('Rain: the path is slick') disappeared after ~2 minutes, so the shower is very short.

Night, all 12 issues open, users floored at 1 and not reaching 0: no game-over or 'your users are gone' beat, the run just idles. At night the boulder is a black silhouette; the only legible things are the red DOWN glows and the HUD text. HUD stays readable at night (good).
